usage: Use PushPanel to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing throughout your application.
PushPanel works well for arranging related content, creating responsive layouts, and maintaining visual consistency. Use it to group related elements and establish clear content boundaries.
